top_choice_rationale: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene is a discovery that originates in a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer and MacDonald, 2011) and was confirmed by the unexpected experimental finding of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle (Jarillo-Herrero, 2018). It has already opened a tunable platform adopted well beyond the originating groups. The citation is limited to the flat-band prediction and the observed phenomena and does not depend on a settled pairing mechanism. I accept that maturity and credit scope (first authors and other groups left out) are real weaknesses and that I am the only member preferring this configuration, so I rank the better-settled quantum spin Hall prize (P002) second and the clean two-name optical lattice clock prize (P001) third, all above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; documented connections (Gross, Rubinstein, Van Riet, Uppsala theory group) are not credited on any proposal
